item.title: 'West Wing' actor Timothy Busfield released from New Mexico jail pending trial
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (AP) — Actor Timothy Busfield was released from jail Tuesday night in New Mexico, where he is facing counts of child sexual abuse .

item.title: Mboko advances to third round at Australian Open, Dabrowski wins doubles opener
item.description: MELBOURNE — Victoria Mboko of Toronto punched her ticket to the third round of women's singles at the Australian Open on Wednesday in Melbourne with a 6-4, 6-3 win over American Caty McNally.

item.title: Devils lean on Glass, Gritsyuk to edge the Oilers 2-1
item.description: EDMONTON — Rookie Arseny Gritsyuk and Cody Glass each had a goal and an assist as the New Jersey Devils held on to beat the Edmonton Oilers 2-1 on Tuesday.

item.title: Man who assassinated former Japanese prime minister gets life in prison
item.description: TOKYO (AP) — A Japanese court sentenced a man who admitted assassinating former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe to life imprisonment on Wednesday, according to NHK public television.

item.title: Adzija scores Torrent's first short-handed goal in 6-4 win over Sceptres
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Lexie Adzija scored Seattle's first short-handed goal of the season in the third period to take the lead for good, and the Torrent beat the Toronto Sceptres 6-4 on Tuesday night to snap a three-game losing streak.

item.title: NHL roundup: Hagel scores twice as Lightning beat Sharks 4-1
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Brandon Hagel scored two goals to reach 25 for the season and surpass Nikita Kucherov for the team lead as the Tampa Bay Lightning continued their surge with a 4-1 win over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night.

item.title: 'Our hearts are shattered': Family grieves Campbell River teen found dead on Australia beach
item.description: The parents of Piper James said on Tuesday that the 19-year-old, whose body was found surrounded by a pack of dingoes, had been "having the trip of her life."
